title: Chat turn navigation follows reading position without fighting live output
description: A long multi-turn chat stays continuously painted during fast scrolling and exposes a compact query navigator whose active marker follows the reading position, previews the correct query, and jumps through the virtual transcript without resuming follow-latest mode.
preconditions: Start web and a server with an isolated long-chat fixture containing at least four user turns.
Use a fine pointer and a chat conversation width of at least 560 px.

steps.target: chat transcript during large wheel deltas in both directions
chat conversation at 748 px, then at the 559/560 and 879/880 px boundaries
below 560 px or with a coarse pointer: role=button[name='会话目录']
choose a turn with ArrowDown and Enter; reopen and dismiss with Escape; reopen and resize to a fine-pointer rail width

assertions.target: real message content intersecting the viewport throughout the scroll
first user message at the transcript reading line
first turn remains selected and scroll-to-latest control remains available
role=navigation[name='Conversation turns'] at 748 px and at every fine-pointer conversation width >= 560 px
role=menu[name='会话目录'] with all user turns and the current turn marked
selected user turn through the virtual transcript; menu closes on selection, Escape or switching to rail mode
chat conversation and composer; message body and composer share left edge and width

cleanup: Close the test tab and stop isolated services.
